solution: Scrapling native challenge handling through the public session.fetch API in the existing account browser context.

source_change.review: Keep the ordinary navigation when there is no challenge. On a precise challenge marker, close the blocked tab, call bounded public fetch with solve_cloudflare enabled, then reopen the owned tab using the same cleared context. Page setup installs the same request-failure listener. Main-frame navigation pacing covers every owned tab. A remaining verification page cannot trigger a password login attempt. All media, identity, lease, encrypted state, immutable event receipt and post pacing behavior remains.

limits.cloud_probe_versions: The actual pinned Linux role has Scrapling 0.4.15; the local Mac has 0.4.8. No package upgrade.
limits.public_api_probe: Same bootstrap flow qualified in an isolated read-only probe using the existing candidate image. A new application image containing the source change has not been built or deployed.
limits.reliability: Two bounded sessions passed, including a fresh clearance challenge; this is not a guarantee of permanent access. Failure remains bounded and leaves events pending without rerunning research.

supersedes: The earlier cloud-account-boundary.json documents a real challenge with challenge handling disabled; it did not test the available handler.
